tools.description: Compute the amortisation schedule for a SPECIFIC mortgage package using that package's real effective rates. tools.name: list_market_indices
tools.description: List market benchmark indices (id, slug, name, currency), sorted by slug. Use this to resolve a benchmark name like 'SORA' into the `marketIndexId` required by `get_index_quotes`.

tools.name: get_index_quotes
tools.description: Return historical quotes (rate by date) for a market benchmark index such as SORA. Requires `marketIndexId` — use `list_market_indices` to resolve a benchmark name/slug into its UUID. Optional `startDate`/`endDate` narrow the range; results are paginated, newest first. tools.name: calculate_affordability
tools.description: Estimate the maximum loan and property price a borrower can afford from income, existing debt commitments and tenure, applying Singapore TDSR/MSR limits. Use this when you know the income and want the budget; to go the other way (a target price → the income needed), use `calculate_required_income`.

tools.name: calculate_required_income
tools.description: Reverse affordability: work out the gross monthly income needed to support a target property price under Singapore TDSR/MSR limits. Use this when you know the target property price; to go the other way (income → maximum budget), use `calculate_affordability`.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage_repayment
tools.description: Compute the monthly repayment, total interest and total cost for a hypothetical loan from an interest rate you supply (standard amortisation). Use this for "what-if" rates; for the real rates of a specific package the borrower has chosen, use `calculate_package_schedule` instead.

tools.name: calculate_refinance_savings
tools.description: Compare a borrower's existing mortgage against a new rate and report monthly savings, total savings and break-even months. Set `mode` to 'original' (supply the original loan amount, tenure and start date) or 'remaining' (supply the current outstanding balance and remaining tenure).

tools.name: calculate_residential_stamp_duty
tools.description: Compute Buyer's Stamp Duty (BSD) and Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty (ABSD) for a Singapore residential purchase, given price/value, buyer type (singaporean | pr | foreigner | entity | trust) and the number of residential properties already owned.

tools.name: calculate_rental_stamp_duty
tools.description: Compute the stamp duty payable on a property lease from the rent and lease term.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage_stamp_duty
tools.description: Compute the stamp duty payable on a mortgage/loan facility.

tools.name: calculate_seller_stamp_duty
tools.description: Compute Seller's Stamp Duty (SSD) from the sale price/value and how long the property has been held.

tools.name: analyze_sell_one_buy_two

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "recommend_packages" is 1635 chars, far longer than this server's median (299). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
